runs.note: The Browse states have no artboard of their own: judged against main-installed-details.dark-modern.1200.png and its spec (design-advisor ruling, P3.1b precedent). singleJudge.finding: [native] The refresh button draws a two-arrow glyph (sync-like), where the artboard and the Extensions view's refresh action draw the single circular-arrow refresh codicon.

[geometry] The Uninstall button (y 116-141) and the version select/Update row (y 148-173) are 6 px apart on a 32 px pitch, where the spec has uninstall-button y 130.2 and version-selector/install-update-button y 160.2, a 4 px gap on a 30 px pitch.

[geometry] The Details tab content starts about 8 px below the tab strip's bottom line: the line is at y 217 and the description's glyph top at y 229. The artboard leaves about 20 px (line at y 241, glyph top at y 265), so the body sits cramped under the tabs.
[geometry] The dependency rows' chevrons start at x 450, 9 px inside the Dependencies heading (x 441), and their labels start at x 465. The artboard puts the chevron at x 446 and the label at x 462.

[native] The header's Refresh button uses the two-arrow sync glyph. The artboard's refresh-button and the workbench's own view Refresh actions use the single circular-arrow refresh glyph, so a VS Code user reads this one as Sync.

[geometry] The details pane's empty-state sentence "Select a package to see its details." starts about 8 px below the pane top (line top near y 85, pane top 77). The artboard starts the details content at the pane's 20 px inset (title line top near y 97), so the message sits tight against the header divider and the pane's top inset no longer matches its side inset of 20.

findings.finding: [native] The split between the result list and the details pane is painted as a 4 px grey band (x 420-423) at rest, where the artboard draws a 1 px settings.sashBorder separator at x 420 with the details pane starting at 421; the sash should be transparent until hovered. | [geometry] The split between the Browse list and the details pane is a solid 4 px band (x 420-423, colour #313131 at rest, no pointer on it), so the details pane starts at x 424. The artboard draws a 1 px separator at x 420 with the pane at 421, the spec puts package-details-panel at x 421, and DS-DIVIDER-6 asks for a 1 px separator under a transparent 4 px sash at rest. | [states] The split between the results list and the details pane is painted as a 4 px grey band (x 420 to 423, rgb 49,49,49) along the full height while at rest. The artboard and DS-DIVIDER-6 draw a 1 px separator (x 420) with a transparent sash.
findings.evidence: the sash at rest, untouched by this item; as P3.1b's `main-updates*#D1`

findings.finding: [native] Rows 2 to 10 show the bundled bright-orange raster box as the default package icon, where the artboard draws the default icon as a neutral grey tile with a codicon package glyph; nine identical saturated boxes do not read like the Extensions view's muted default icon. | [states] The Browse rows without their own icon (rows 2 to 10) draw the bright orange raster box of resources/package-icon.png with no tile, where the artboard draws a package without an icon as the codicon `package` in icon.foreground on a 36 px dark tile. The default icon reads as decoration in a colour role the workbench does not use.
findings.evidence: the default package icon is the host's `data-package-icon` raster; P7.1 carries it from UX-P2.8b (`main-installed-single#D4`)

findings.finding: [native] The details header is squeezed against the artboard and DS-INSET-4: the title ink starts 13 px below the pane top (artboard 25 px, i.e. a 20 px header inset), the controls sit 12 px higher (version select y 148 vs spec 160.2), only about 8 px separate the Update row from the Details/README strip (artboard 20 px), and the description starts 12 px under the tab strip (artboard 24 px). | [geometry] The details header is squeezed against the artboard. The title's glyph top is at y 90, 13 px below the pane top, where the artboard has it at y 102 (25 px). Only 8 px separate the Update button's bottom (y 173) from the Details/README strip (top y 182), where the spec has 20 (185.2 to 206.2). Content starts 16 px from the pane edge instead of 20, so the header uses about 8/16/8 instead of 20 on every side.
findings.evidence: the details header's insets; the P3.3b row carries them

findings.finding: [native] The inline error copy reads "The search failed: The package source could not be read.", which is two capitalised clauses built on "failed". The design system's failure pattern is one sentence of the form "<What> could not be searched: <reason>." and avoids "failed" for a read (§10.8; DS-STATE-4 asks for one sentence). | [states] The Browse error message joins two messages with a colon and restarts with a capital ('The search failed: The package source could not be read.'). It is a stitched prefix plus a second capitalised sentence, where DS-STATE-4 calls for one sentence and the sentence-case copy rules allow no capital after a colon.
findings.evidence: the composed error family, beside P3.1b's Updates error: `The packages could not be searched: <reason>.`
